title: Five Places to Go in Bogotá
abstract: A growing collection of small businesses — from restaurants to boutiques — make the quiet, centrally located neighborhood of Quinta Camacho a welcome escape in the bustling capital.

title: Five Places to Go in Kigali
abstract: A former red-light district in Rwanda’s capital has become red hot, buzzing with trendy bars, artsy boutiques, bakeries and clubs.
